Sandbox_OffGrid_BankScale_tooltip: Scales how much every battery stores.
Sandbox_OffGrid_DegradeBank_tooltip: Running batteries flat costs capacity permanently. Cheap chemistries start suffering far sooner than sealed ones.
Sandbox_OffGrid_LinkRadius_tooltip: How far each component reaches to find the next one. Banks chain, so a run of them can lead away from the controller.
Sandbox_OffGrid_OutputScale_tooltip: Scales everything the panels make. 100 is the physical model.
Sandbox_OffGrid_PickupLock: Who may pick up solar parts
Sandbox_OffGrid_PickupLock_option3: Whoever placed it, their safehouse, admins and moderators
Sandbox_OffGrid_PickupLock_tooltip: Panels and battery banks are expensive to build and trivial to carry off. Mods that remove the tool requirement for moving furniture otherwise make every rig free to take.
Sandbox_OffGrid_SimulateLoad_tooltip: Count what the lights, fridges and ovens in range are drawing. Off means the system only ever charges.
Sandbox_OffGrid_SnowRate_tooltip: How fast snow covers the glass. 0 means it never settles. Roof panels collect faster and shed slower whatever this is set to.
Sandbox_OffGrid_SoilRate_tooltip: How fast dirt cuts output. Rain washes panels either way.
